tracking: ADR-0230 A2 (P19, Lane L3): API-only by the master decision in the Lane L3 brief 2026-11-14, recorded in ADR-0230, section Recorded decision (2026-11-14); the SAP business server screen is built by the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/servers/:serverId/system-class: shows whether a server is marked SAP business and which seeded approval rule and rate limit are in force
gaps.POST /v1/servers/:serverId/system-class: marks a server SAP business and seeds its write-only quorum approval rule and rate limit
gaps.DELETE /v1/servers/:serverId/system-clas: unmarks an SAP business server (settings_relax step-up)
